import nbformat
from nbconvert.preprocessors import ExecutePreprocessor
from nbconvert import HTMLExporter
from pathlib import Path

infile = Path('FGBR_OC.ipynb')
out_nb = Path('../results/FGBR_OC_executed.ipynb')
out_html = Path('../results/FGBR_OC_executed.html')

nb = nbformat.read(infile, as_version=4)
ep = ExecutePreprocessor(timeout=None, kernel_name='python3', allow_errors=True)
ep.preprocess(nb, {'metadata': {'path': '/code'}})
nbformat.write(nb, out_nb)
body, resources = HTMLExporter().from_notebook_node(nb)
out_html.write_text(body, encoding='utf-8')
print('done')
